title: Buckswood .buck graph.json 1.0
description: Structural rules of graph.json (docs/BUCK_FORMAT.md §4–§6, §11). Semantic rules (references exist, port kinds, DAG without cycles, working spaces, keyframe ordering, size and JSON depth limits, duplicate keys, ordered parameter pairs) are enforced by src/buck/validate.ts, which is normative for this repository.
